mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 2% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0 index), manufacturing output expansion signals strong corporate capacity utilization and rising profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real GDP level (GDPC1) from the prior quarter signals economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where GDPC1 increases by at least 0.5% from the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of slowing labor market growth (PAYEMS growth rate below 0.2% monthly), job creation deceleration signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where PAYEMS growth rate is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 index, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO falls below 95.0.
